messages:
alex: Heads up — prepping eu-west-2 GPU canary pool for Q2 onboarding. Need to request quota increases before Thursday: per-AZ ENI limit raise (we plan ~120 GPU nodes per AZ, need attachable ENIs + secondary IPs), VPC IPv4 address pool headroom, and a small pool of spare EIPs for NAT failover. Can someone own opening the support case? /cc @priya

priya: I can do it. Can you paste target numbers? also do we need IPv6 prefix delegation too?

alex: Target numbers: per-AZ ENI quota -> increase from 5000 to 9000 (covers pods with hostNetwork & eni plugins + future autoscale). Secondary private IPs per VPC -> request bump from 65536 to 98304 (cross-AZ). EIP pool: reserve 60 public IPs across 3 AZs (20 each) to use for NAT GW HA and ephemeral load. IPv6: yes, ask for a /56 delegatable prefix for the VPC and an extra /64 per AZ if possible.

julian: 60 EIPs sounds pricey. Can we use NAT Gateway with Elastic IP per AZ only? why reserve 20/az?

alex: Reason: Dedicated GPU pools spawn short-lived instances for canaries and data-plane ops + we want spare EIPs for quick replacement during AZ failover + avoid hitting soft limits during canary ramp. Also some provider partners need static IPs.

maria: FYI cost estimate: EIP reserve across accounts costs $0.005/hr per unused EIP -> ~60*0.005*24*30 =~ $216/month. ok to proceed?

priya: ok I'll open AWS support ticket. Drafting message — sending here for review:

priya: ```
Subject: Request increase: EC2 ENI, Elastic IPs, VPC IP limits, IPv6 delegation for account acc-redwood-prod-eu-west-2

Account: 123456789012
Region: eu-west-2
Requested increases:
- EC2: ENI quota per AZ from 5000 -> 9000
- EC2: Private IPv4 addresses per VPC from 65536 -> 98304
- EC2: Elastic IP addresses: request reservation of 60 EIPs (20 per AZ)
- VPC IPv6: request a /56 for VPC and ability to allocate /64 per subnet across AZs

Use case: launching GPU dedicated canary and dedicated pools, autoscaling with secondary IPs for pod networking, require NAT HA and partner fixed IPs. Priority: High (launch window 72h).
Contact: priya@redwood.ai, infra pager
```

alex: looks good. Add: please include that we'll be using EIPs with NAT gateways and EC2 Elastic IP Association for failover. And mention we'll accept per-account staged approval.

infra-bot: Support case created: 01234567890 — AWS response ETA ~48 hours. Assigned to cloud-ops.

cloud-ops: We'll also open a parallel request with our cloud provider partner for reserved floating IPs. Tracking doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/infra/regions/eu-west-2-ip-bump

julian: Also, can we add a note to ask for ENI quota increase conditional limit per VPC vs per account? some limits are region-account scoped. ask for both.

priya: updated and re-sent. case 01234567890 updated with per-account + per-VPC notes. Adding monitoring alert: low free EIP headroom.

alex: Thanks. I'll schedule a canary start after we get confirmation. :thumbsup:
